Claude review

Checks whether the content really answers its questions and writes the fixes.

Settings

Stored only in this browser (chrome.storage.local) and sent only to api.anthropic.com. Anyone with access to this Chrome profile can read it. Create a key at console.anthropic.com.

Scoring rules follow "AEO & GEO: A Developer's Implementation Guide" (Nov 2026). There is no standard AEO score; this one weights crawler access 25%, structure 20%, answer-first content 20%, head tags 15%, structured data 10% and trust signals 10%.
